name: Hxney
text: If you plan on a trip to a japan, and youtube videos and endless websites full of itinerary's which can be overwhelming, buying this will help so much!!! Worth every penny! Made my japan trip planning 100x easier. With many tips and tricks and lots of ideas of things to do. It is obvious this was made with love as it is so detailed. Thank you!

name: Saul
text: This guide was amazing and extremely helpful! It allowed me to better plan what my days would look like and allowed me to deviate because there were so many alternative suggestions. Highly recommend

name: Kim J.
text: Worth the purchase! Very informative and helpful for my trip. Very responsive when I had a question. Would definitely purchase from the creator again.

name: Karina S.
text: Súper helpful in planning our first ever trip to Japan! Really love having this as a starting point of where to go and what to do!

name: Etsy buyer
text: Fantastic! I actually live in Japan (for work & have been here over the last 18 months) and really wanted some ideas instead of reinventing the wheel. This is so perfect to help me maximise those tourist destinations and attractions which will help me plan my weekends etc :-)

name: Etsy buyer
text: This itinerary is so helpful! I bought it more as a starting point to write out my own family’s itinerary for Japan and didn’t want to start from scratch, but there’s a ton of useful stuff in here that we will add to ours! I’m going to print our edited version and add some blank pages so it will double as a journal for our family trip. Editing in Canva has been so easy. Thank you!!!!

name: Saskia
text: It was such a great help for my Japan preparations, thank you so much 💖 Greetings from Germany 👋

name: Jia Le C.
text: Beautiful and simple designed, lots of variety
